 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Transpose, then extend by mirror reflections in both axes.
    tile = [list(row) for row in zip(*grid)]
    n, m = len(tile), len(tile[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(3 * n):
        br, ir = divmod(r, n)
        source_r = ir if br % 2 == 0 else n - 1 - ir
        row = []
        for bc in range(3):
            for j in range(m):
                source_c = j if bc % 2 == 0 else m - 1 - j
                row.append(tile[source_r][source_c])
        out.append(row)
    return out
